enunciado: Solve the Towers of Hanoi for 3 disks showing each move ("disk d: X -> Y") and the total number of moves. Then show the total for 10 disks without printing the moves.
objetivos: Trust recursion: solve n using the solution for n - 1
pistas: Move n - 1 disks to the spare peg, disk n to the target and the n - 1 on top.
Base case: with 0 disks there is nothing to do.
Use a bool parameter to decide whether to print.
